description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to safe prime generation, modular arithmetic, and primality testing, specifically for the SRP (Secure Remote Password) protocol. It includes functions for generating safe primes, checking primality, modular exponentiation, and Montgomery multiplication, with references to big number operations and prime testing routines.

methods.name: t_makeconfent
methods.description: Generates a configuration entry with a safe prime modulus and generator based on specified size.

methods.name: t_makeconfent_c
methods.description: Generates a configuration entry with a different prime generation method, possibly for cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: t_newconfent
methods.description: Initializes a new configuration entry with empty modulus and generator.

methods.name: t_putconfent
methods.description: Outputs a configuration entry to a file in base64-encoded format.

methods.name: BigIntegerBitLen
methods.description: Returns the bit length of a BigInteger.

methods.name: BigIntegerCheckPrime
methods.description: Performs a probabilistic primality test on a BigInteger.

methods.name: BigIntegerModInt
methods.description: Computes the modulus of a BigInteger with an unsigned int.

methods.name: BigIntegerMod
methods.description: Computes the modulus of a BigInteger with another BigInteger.

methods.name: BigIntegerLShift
methods.description: Left shifts a BigInteger by a specified number of bits.

methods.name: BN_is_prime
methods.description: Checks if a BIGNUM is probably prime using multiple tests.

methods.name: BN_mod_word
methods.description: Computes the modulus of a BIGNUM with an unsigned long.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp_mont
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation using Montgomery multiplication.

methods.name: BN_from_montgomery
methods.description: Converts a Montgomery form number back to standard form.

methods.name: BN_value_one
methods.description: Returns a BIGNUM representing the value one.
